edges.step_hint: Walk straight ahead from the Main Gate toward the Admin Block
Turn right after the Main Gate and follow the paved path to Student Services
Student Services is directly beside the Admin Block
Continue past Admin Block on the central campus road to Block A
Walk straight past Student Services to reach Block A
Follow the covered walkway from Block A to Block B
Continue along the covered walkway from Block B to Block C
Turn right at the end of Block B to reach the CSE Department entrance
Turn right at the end of Block C to reach the ECE Department entrance
Turn left past Block A and walk up to the Central Library
Walk directly north from Block B to the Library
From the Library, take the path west to the Canteen
From the Library, take the path east past the amphitheatre to the Auditorium
Walk east from the Canteen along the back road to the Auditorium
From the Auditorium, continue east to the Sports Complex
Turn right from Block C and walk north-east to the Sports Complex
From Student Services walk north following signage to the Canteen
Walk east along the department row from CSE to ECE
